name: grocery-order-desk
description: AI-powered order desk for Sharma General Store (MERN + Gemini)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('server/.env')){fs.copyFileSync('server/.env.example','server/.env');console.log('Created server/.env - fill in MONGODB_URI, GEMINI_API_KEY, SHOPKEEPER_PASSWORD and JWT_SECRET')}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
